title: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier
abstract: arXiv:2610.32223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Websites and applications deploy CAPTCHAs and anti-automation mechanisms that use behavioral signals such as interaction trajectories and timing, not outcomes alone, to distinguish humans from automated agents. We call these protected GUI environments, where correctly solving a verification task is insufficient for end-to-end task completion. Agents must turn solver outputs into accepted interactions and adapt execution to runtime feedback under time constraints. We introduce SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework combining hierarchical solving with runtime supervision. A hierarchical solving tree decomposes verification into interdependent Perceive, Ground, Solve, Act, and Verify capabilities. A runtime supervisor grounds action commitments in tool-derived evidence, revises them as evidence arrives, and mediates execution under explicit recovery budgets. translated_title: 正确答案，紧闭的大门：面向验证屏障下GUI智能体的SolveBind框架
translated_abstract: 网站和应用程序部署了验证码（CAPTCHA）及反自动化机制，这些机制利用交互轨迹和时机等行为信号——而非仅凭结果——来区分人类与自动化智能体。我们将这类受保护的GUI环境称为“验证屏障”（verification barrier），在这种环境中，仅正确解决验证任务并不足以完成端到端任务。智能体必须将求解器的输出转化为被系统接受的交互，并在时间限制下根据运行时反馈调整执行过程。我们提出SolveBind，一个将分层求解与运行时监督相结合的GUI智能体框架。分层求解树将验证过程分解为相互依赖的感知、定位、求解、行动与验证五种能力。运行时监督器将行动承诺建立在工具生成的证据之上，随着证据到来不断修订，并在明确的恢复预算约束下调停执行。在九个验证码任务族和九个骨干模型上，SolveBind取得了最高的……
tldr: 该论文提出SolveBind框架，通过分层求解树（感知-定位-求解-行动-验证）与运行时监督相结合，使GUI智能体能够突破验证码等反自动化机制构成的“验证屏障”，将正确的求解输出转化为被系统接受的交互，从而完成端到端任务。
en_tdlr: SolveBind is a GUI-agent framework that combines a hierarchical solving tree (Perceive, Ground, Solve, Act, Verify) with runtime supervision to overcome the "verification barrier" posed by CAPTCHAs and anti-automation mechanisms, turning correct solver outputs into accepted interactions for end-to-end task completion.
